title: Official GeoServer 3.0.1 REST, WFS, and WMS migration comparison

source.description: Digest-pinned official GeoServer 3.0.1 runs as a disposable loopback container, receives one OpenGeo exact-generation export through its real REST catalog, and serves bounded WFS/WMS comparison outputs.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: The exact official GeoServer image accepts a workspace, Shapefile store, and feature type through its authenticated REST catalog while missing REST authority is denied.
GeoServer serves the exported governed feature through bbox-filtered WFS 2.0 GeoJSON and WMS 1.3 capabilities/PNG with the LineString-to-MultiLineString promotion declared.
One exact-generation OpenGeo collection migrates through an open GDAL/Shapefile handoff with stable UUID, fields, coordinates, and explicit geometry loss.
